answer.reason: Both are regulated, asset-owning utilities that deliver electricity to residential and commercial customers. Con Edison also delivers gas and steam in dense New York metro areas. AP&T is a small, remote Alaska utility that mixes hydro-based power with a large telephone and broadband business. The electric overlap is real, but the product mix, geography and scale differ, and the telecom business is material for the comp. That makes it adjacent rather than a direct peer.

T:P2.2.text: Explore the business segments that make up the Con Edison company and revenue for each segment.

T:P2.3.text: Con Edison's principal business segments are Consolidated Edison Company of New York, a regulated electric, gas, and steam utility; Orange & Rockland Utilities (O&R), a regulated electric and gas utility; and Con Edison Transmission, Inc.

T:P2.4.text: Con Edison of New York provides electric service to multiple million customers and gas service to multiple million customers in New York City and Westchester County. The company also provides steam service in parts of Manhattan. Visit Con Edison’s website.

T:P2.5.text: Orange & Rockland provides electric service to multiple customers in southeastern New York and adjacent areas of northern New Jersey and gas service to multiple customers in southeastern New York. Visit Orange & Rockland’s website.

T:P2.6.text: Con Edison Transmission invests in electric and natural gas transmission projects that offer customers access to diverse, low-cost energy supplies. Visit Con Edison Transmission’s website.

C:P1.1.text: Alaska Power & Telephone | Internet, Phone & Power

C:P1.2.text: Alaska Power & Telephone delivers reliable Internet, phone, and power services across Alaska, connecting communities with dependable local service.

C:P1.3.text: Alaska’s Best Fiber Internet & Energy Provider

C:P1.6.text: We are an employee-owned utility dedicated to serving over 40 Alaska communities with reliable power, broadband, and telephone services. we’ve built our reputation on trust, innovation, and a deep commitment to the people and places we serve.

C:P1.7.text: Whether you’re a residential customer looking for dependable energy, a business seeking enterprise connectivity, or a visitor checking local conditions via our popular webcam feature, AP&T is here to support your journey.

C:P1.8.text: Our fiber and microwave networks connect homes and businesses with speeds up to 2.5 Gbps—competitive with national providers.

C:P1.9.text: We deliver reliable energy from the Arctic Circle to Southeastern Alaska, with hydroelectric power playing a key role of our sustainable solution.

C:P1.10.text: Use SmartHub to pay & manage your account, find quick answers to common questions, and check the weather with Live Webcams.

C:P1.11.text: Empowering our communities empowers us all.

C:P1.12.text: AP&T delivers reliable utility services to over 40 remote Alaska communities and villages across 1,100 linear miles. With a strong commitment to sustainability, approximately 75% of AP&T’s energy is generated from renewable hydropower. In select areas, surplus energy supports beneficial electrification initiatives—such as heat pump installations and electric vehicle adoption—driving clean energy growth and long-term environmental resilience.

C:P2.1.text: AP&T Business Services | Reliable Solutions for Your Business

C:P2.2.text: AP&T Business Services delivers reliable, scalable solutions to help your business operate efficiently and grow with confidence.

C:P2.3.text: Business Internet, Data Services, Calling Solutions, & Energy Solutions

C:P2.4.text: We deliver the personalized service of a small, local company, but offer advanced technology solutions and resources of a large enterprise.

C:P2.5.text: At AP&T, we provide the advanced connectivity and energy solutions businesses need to thrive. From high-speed broadband and custom data services to reliable telephone and energy services, our business solutions are built on cutting edge infrastructure—including regional fiber networks and 24/7 support.

C:P2.6.text: With local technicians, dedicated account monitoring, and dependable, Alaska proven technology, we deliver the performance of a major provider with the hands on support of a local partner.

C:P2.7.text: Broadband business internet is a high-speed internet connection specifically tailored to businesses. Broadband business internet makes sure to have enough bandwidth, connectivity, and connection for your business needs throughout the entire process. Broadband also offers reliable download and upload speeds to accommodate your needs.
